svg.title: Yossef Khalil — terminal profile
svg.desc: An animated terminal profile for Yossef Khalil, an AI/ML engineer, AI automation engineer and software engineer in Alexandria. Panes show Manzili, Clinic EHR and AI-DA, plus a year of GitHub activity.
